description:
Use this when the user asks how an Indian sector or industry looks in aggregate: number of companies, market cap, valuation and returns.

Returns, for each group, the number of companies, total market cap, median and average P/E and median P/B, and where available the median dividend yield and one-year return. `grain` is "sector" (default), "igroup" (SEBI industry) or "isubgroup" (SEBI basic industry). Omit `sector` to list every group; pass a name at that grain for one group, and a name that is not recognised returns the valid ones. Totals only: no company rows.
name: get_sector_overview
title: Sector overview
